highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Cisco warns of FMC static credential flaw exploited in zero-day attacks and Amazon identifies North Korean hacker group behind open-source supply chain attacks. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: When AppSec Scanners Become a Supply Chain Attack Vector. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Dealing with AI-Generated Extortion. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
